{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string with commas to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
internal_test_count = internal_test_mask.sum()

# Check status
status_counts = sales['status'].value_counts()

# Create mask for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
completed_mask = sales['status'] == 'completed'
valid_mask = completed_mask & ~internal_test_mask

# Filter valid orders
valid_orders = sales[valid_mask]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = valid_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print only the required numbers
print(f"internal_test_count = {internal_test_count}")
print(f"status_counts = {status_counts.to_dict()}")
print(f"total_revenue = {total_revenue}")"}
